note: The All Promos listing at /promos is a Drupal view (inner_pages_promos_grid) with nine promo-card tiles per page and a pager that went to ?page=28 (29 pages) on 2026-11-24. Category filters (Dining, Shopping, Travel, Horizons, Home Loan, Komo, and others) are subsets of this list. Horizons is a magazine path (/promos/horizons) and is not this grid. Some tiles are not credit-card offers; filter after reading the detail page. The first page of the listing does not include every current Cards Promos slide from the credit cards page (for example /promos/php-4-unioil-0); later listing pages or the sitemap may.
